convars.name: r_draw_particle_children_with_parents

convars.label: Your bullet tracers

convars.name: r_drawviewmodel

convars.label: Effects bloom

convars.name: r_enable_cubemap_fog

convars.name: r_enable_gradient_fog

convars.name: r_enable_rigid_animation
convars.label: Rigid animation

convars.name: r_enable_volume_fog

convars.name: r_fallback_texture_lod_scale

convars.name: r_farz

convars.name: r_flashlightbrightness
convars.label: Flashlight brightness
convars.description: Brightness of flashlight-type lights.

convars.name: r_frame_sync_enable
convars.label: Frame sync

convars.name: r_fullscreen_gamma
convars.description: Changes gamma when the game uses fullscreen mode.

convars.name: r_grass_end_fade

convars.description: Distance at which grass is fully faded out.

convars.name: r_grass_quality

convars.name: r_grass_start_fade
convars.label: Grass fade start
convars.description: Distance at which grass starts fading out.

convars.name: r_hair_ao
convars.label: Hair ambient occlusion
convars.description: Ambient occlusion pass for hair.

convars.name: r_hair_indirect_transmittance
convars.label: Hair light transmission
convars.description: Indirect light passing through hair.

convars.name: r_hair_shadowtile
convars.label: Hair shadow tiles
convars.description: Hair shadowing pass. Off, hero hair loses its self-shadowing.

convars.name: r_haircull_percent
convars.label: Hair cull percent
convars.description: Valve doesn't document this setting.

convars.name: r_impacts_alt_orientation
convars.label: Alternate impact orientation
convars.description: Valve doesn't document this setting.

convars.name: r_late_particle_job_sync
convars.label: Late particle job sync

convars.name: r_light_flickering_enabled
convars.label: Flickering lights
convars.description: Flickering light effects where the map uses them.

convars.name: r_light_sensitivity_mode
convars.label: Reduce flashing effects
convars.description: The in-game Reduce flashing effects accessibility setting.

convars.name: r_lightmap_bicubic_filtering
convars.label: Bicubic lightmap filtering
convars.description: Not in Valve's current convar dump.

convars.name: r_lightmap_size
convars.label: Max lightmap resolution
convars.description: Maximum lightmap resolution. Lower values make baked lighting blurrier.

convars.name: r_lightmap_size_directional_irradiance
convars.label: Directional lightmap resolution
convars.description: Maximum resolution of the directional irradiance lightmap channel. -1 uses r_lightmap_size.

convars.name: r_limit_particle_job_duration
convars.label: Limit particle job duration
convars.description: Limits how long particle jobs may run per frame.

convars.name: r_lod
convars.label: Model LOD
convars.description: Not in Valve's current convar dump.

convars.name: r_low_latency
convars.label: NVIDIA Reflex / AMD Anti-Lag 2
convars.description: 0 off, 1 on, 2 on with boost (NVIDIA only). Shown in the menu as NVIDIA Reflex.

convars.name: r_mapextents
convars.label: Map extents
convars.description: Maximum map dimension, which sets the far clipping plane.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream FAQ: buildings pop in and out.

convars.name: r_max_portal_render_targets
convars.label: Doorman door views
convars.description: Maximum number of Doorman doors rendered at once.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream: 1 causes visual bugs; use 2, or 0 to turn the doors' views off.

convars.name: r_monitor_3dskybox
convars.label: 3D skybox in monitors
convars.description: Draws the 3D skybox in monitor views.

convars.name: r_morphing_enabled
convars.label: Morph targets
convars.description: Vertex morph targets such as facial expressions.

convars.name: r_multiscattering
convars.label: Multiscattering
convars.description: Not in Valve's current convar dump.

convars.name: r_muzzleflashbrightness
convars.label: Muzzle flash brightness
convars.description: Brightness of muzzle flash lights.

convars.name: r_nearz
convars.label: Near clip distance
convars.description: Overrides the near clipping plane; -1 uses the default.

convars.name: r_particle_allowprerender
convars.label: Particle prerender
convars.description: Allows particle systems to prerender.

convars.name: r_particle_batch_collections
convars.label: Batch particle collections
convars.description: Batches collections of particles when rendering.

convars.name: r_particle_cables_cast_shadows
convars.label: Cable particle shadows
convars.description: Lets cable and rope particle effects cast shadows.

convars.name: r_particle_cables_render
convars.label: Render cable particles
convars.description: Renders cable and rope particle effects.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream: off breaks Lash's ultimate.

convars.name: r_particle_explicit_fetch
convars.label: Explicit particle fetch
convars.description: Not in Valve's current convar dump.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream notes soul orbs get harder to see.

convars.name: r_particle_fixedrandomseeds
convars.label: Fixed particle random seeds
convars.description: Uses fixed random seeds for particles (a debugging aid). Effects repeat the same pattern.

convars.name: r_particle_max_detail_level
convars.label: Particle detail level
convars.description: Highest particle detail level spawned; 0 spawns only the cheapest variants.

convars.name: r_particle_max_draw_distance
convars.label: Particle draw distance
convars.description: Distance beyond which particles are not drawn.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream: too low and trooper health bars disappear.

convars.name: r_particle_max_size_cull
convars.label: Particle cull size limit
convars.description: Particle systems larger than this in every dimension skip CPU culling and are drawn anyway.

convars.name: r_particle_max_texture_layers
convars.label: Particle texture layers
convars.description: Caps the texture layers a particle material uses. -1 means no cap.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream: below 4, Infernus' afterburn, Paige's fire and Drifter's passive look blocky.

convars.name: r_particle_min_timestep
convars.label: Particle minimum timestep
convars.description: Particles simulated more often than this interpolate instead. Higher values make effects step visibly.

convars.name: r_particle_mixed_resolution_viewstart
convars.label: Particle mixed resolution start
convars.description: Distance at which particles start rendering at reduced resolution.

convars.name: r_particle_model_new8
convars.label: Particle model new8
convars.description: Valve doesn't document this setting.

convars.name: r_particle_model_per_thread_count
convars.label: Particle models per thread
convars.description: How many particle models one worker thread handles.

convars.name: r_particle_newinput
convars.label: Particle input path
convars.description: Input path in particle operators.

convars.name: r_particle_skip_postsim
convars.label: Skip particle post-simulation
convars.description: Skips the post-simulation step for particles. Valve doesn't document this setting.

convars.name: r_particle_timescale
convars.label: Particle speed
convars.description: Speed of particle simulation. Above 1, effects play faster and visibly end before the ability does.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream: desyncs Infernus' ultimate visuals from its duration.

convars.name: r_physics_particle_op_spawn_scale
convars.label: Physics particle spawns
convars.description: Scale on particles spawned by physics operators. 0 stops those spawns.

convars.name: r_pipeline_stats_use_flush_api
convars.label: Pipeline stats flush
convars.description: Experimental: uses ID3D11DeviceContext::Flush instead of queries to flush the GPU pipeline (DirectX 11).

convars.name: r_post_bloom
convars.label: Post-process bloom
convars.description: The in-game Post process bloom setting. Your menu choice is saved in video.txt and wins over gameinfo.gi.

convars.name: r_postprocess_enable
convars.label: Post-processing
convars.description: Master switch for post-processing.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream notes the game looks grey without it.

convars.name: r_propsmaxdist
convars.label: Prop draw distance
convars.description: Maximum distance at which client-side props are visible.

convars.name: r_RainParticleDensity
convars.label: Rain density
convars.description: Density of rain particles, 0 to 1.

convars.name: r_render_hair
convars.label: Render hair
convars.description: Renders hair. Off, heroes with hair render without it.

convars.name: r_renderdoc_auto_shader_pdbs
convars.label: RenderDoc shader debug info
convars.description: Generates shader debug info when a RenderDoc capture is taken. Only matters with RenderDoc attached.

convars.name: r_rendersun
convars.label: Render sun
convars.description: Renders sun lighting.

convars.name: r_ropetranslucent
convars.label: Translucent ropes
convars.description: Draws ropes with translucency.

convars.name: r_shadows
convars.label: Shadows (master switch)
convars.description: Master switch for shadow rendering.

convars.name: r_size_cull_threshold
convars.label: Small-object culling
convars.description: Objects smaller than this percentage of the screen are not drawn. Higher values cull more.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream FAQ: high values hide crates and trooper health bars at a distance.

convars.name: r_size_cull_threshold_fade
convars.description: Sets how far above the screen-size cutoff objects start fading. Use 0 to turn off that fade.

convars.name: r_size_cull_threshold_shadow
convars.label: Shadow small-object cull
convars.description: Objects smaller than this percentage of the shadow map are left out of it. Higher values drop shadows from more objects.

convars.name: r_skip_precache_validation_check
convars.label: Skip precache validation
convars.description: Skips validating that resources were precached.

convars.name: r_smooth_morph_normals
convars.label: Smooth morph normals
convars.description: Smooths normals on morphed meshes.

convars.name: r_ssao
convars.label: Screen-space ambient occlusion
convars.description: Contact shadows in corners and creases.

convars.name: r_ssao_blur
convars.label: SSAO blur
convars.description: Blur pass that smooths screen-space ambient occlusion. Off, AO looks noisier.

convars.name: r_ssao_strength
convars.label: SSAO strength
convars.description: Strength of screen-space ambient occlusion. 0 removes its contribution.

convars.name: r_strip_invisible_during_sceneobject_update
convars.label: Strip invisible scene objects
convars.description: Removes invisible objects while updating scene objects.

convars.name: r_texture_budget_dynamic
convars.label: Dynamic texture budget
convars.description: Adjusts the texture streaming budget to the GPU's memory use.

convars.name: r_texture_budget_threshold
convars.label: Texture budget threshold
convars.description: Fraction of the texture budget at which the texture pool starts shrinking.

convars.name: r_texture_budget_update_period
convars.label: Texture budget update period
convars.description: Seconds between texture memory budget updates.

convars.name: r_texture_lod_scale
convars.label: Texture size scale
convars.description: Scale on the texture size streaming requests. Higher values are blurrier.

convars.name: r_texture_nonstreaming_load
convars.description: Allows the game to load mip levels when it reads a texture header, which can reduce later disk reads and delays.

convars.name: r_texture_pool_reduce_rate
convars.label: Texture pool shrink rate
convars.description: MB per second the texture pool shrinks by when over budget.

convars.name: r_texture_pool_size
convars.label: Texture pool size
convars.description: Total size of the texture pool in MB. Smaller pools stream lower-resolution textures sooner.

convars.name: r_texture_stream_max_resolution
convars.label: Max texture resolution
convars.description: Caps the resolution of the top streamed mip level. The engine minimum is 512.

convars.name: r_texture_stream_mip_bias
convars.label: Texture quality (mip bias)
convars.description: Streams lower-resolution texture mips: the in-game Texture quality setting uses 0 High, 1 Med, 2 Low. Higher values are blurrier.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream: above 4, the Sinner's Sacrifice lights turn into small triangles unless the Sinner light fix addon is installed.

convars.name: r_texturefilteringquality
convars.label: Texture filtering
convars.description: 0 bilinear, 1 trilinear, 2 to 5 anisotropic 2x to 16x. Lower values blur textures at an angle.

convars.name: r_threaded_particles
convars.label: Threaded particles
convars.description: Simulates particles on worker threads.

convars.name: r_translucent
convars.label: Translucent geometry
convars.description: Renders translucent geometry.

convars.name: r_update_particles_on_render_only_frames
convars.label: Update particles on render-only frames
convars.description: Updates particles on frames that render without a simulation tick.

convars.name: r_use_memory_budget_model
convars.description: Estimates the GPU memory budget internally instead of asking the operating system.

convars.name: r_vma_defrag_algorithm
convars.description: Selects GPU memory defragmentation mode. Use 0 for fast, 1 for balanced, 2 for full, or 3 for extensive.

convars.name: r_world_wind_frequency_grass
convars.label: Grass wind frequency
convars.description: Frequency of wind animation on grass.

convars.name: r_world_wind_frequency_trees
convars.label: Tree wind frequency
convars.description: Frequency of wind animation on trees.

convars.name: r_world_wind_strength
convars.label: Wind strength
convars.description: Strength of world wind that sways grass and trees. 0 stops it.

convars.name: ragdoll_parallel_pose_control
convars.label: Parallel ragdoll poses
convars.description: Computes ragdoll pose control on worker threads.

convars.name: rope_collide
convars.label: Rope collision
convars.description: Lets ropes collide with the world.

convars.name: rope_smooth_enlarge
convars.label: Rope smoothing enlarge
convars.description: How much ropes are enlarged on screen for their anti-aliasing effect.

convars.name: rope_smooth_maxalpha
convars.label: Rope smoothing max alpha
convars.description: Maximum alpha of the rope anti-aliasing effect.

convars.name: rope_smooth_maxalphawidth
convars.label: Rope smoothing max alpha width
convars.description: Screen width at which rope smoothing reaches its maximum alpha.

convars.name: rope_smooth_minalpha
convars.label: Rope smoothing min alpha
convars.description: Minimum alpha of the rope anti-aliasing effect.

convars.name: rope_smooth_minwidth
convars.label: Rope smoothing min width
convars.description: Minimum on-screen width a smoothed rope shrinks to.

convars.name: rope_subdiv
convars.label: Rope subdivision
convars.description: Rope subdivision level, 0 to 8. Lower values make ropes more angular.

convars.name: rope_wind_dist
convars.label: Rope wind distance
convars.description: Ropes past this distance don't get small wind gusts.

convars.name: rtx_dynamic_blas
convars.description: Lets ray tracing create acceleration structures for geometry animated by compute shader skinning.

convars.name: rtx_dynamic_blas_caching
convars.description: Reuses a dynamic ray tracing acceleration structure while its geometry stays unchanged.

convars.name: rtx_force_default_hitgroup
convars.description: Uses the default ray tracing hit shaders for all geometry, including geometry with specialized shaders.

convars.name: rtx_texture_resolution
convars.description: Sets which texture resolution ray tracing requests from the streamer.

convars.name: sc_aggregate_bvh_threshold
convars.label: Aggregate BVH threshold
convars.description: Threshold for building bounding volume hierarchies for aggregate meshes.

convars.name: sc_aggregate_gpu_culling
convars.description: Lets the GPU discard aggregate meshes that do not need drawing.

convars.name: sc_aggregate_render_mesh_shader
convars.description: Draws aggregate geometry with mesh shaders when the GPU supports them.

convars.name: sc_allow_dithered_lod
convars.label: Dithered LOD transitions
convars.description: Dithers between levels of detail. Off, models switch detail in one step.

convars.name: sc_barnlight_enable_precomputed_vis
convars.description: Lets barn lights use precomputed visibility. A map restart is required.

convars.name: sc_cache_envmap_lpv_lookup
convars.label: Cache reflection probe lookups
convars.description: Caches which environment map and light probe each object samples.

convars.name: sc_clutter_density_full_size
convars.label: Clutter full-density size
convars.description: Screen size at which clutter is drawn at full density.

convars.name: sc_clutter_density_none_size
convars.label: Clutter cutoff size
convars.description: Screen size below which clutter is not drawn.

convars.name: sc_clutter_enable
convars.label: Clutter
convars.description: Small clutter props.

convars.name: sc_disable_shadow_materials
convars.label: Disable shadow materials
convars.description: Not in Valve's current convar dump; configs set it to skip special shadow materials.

convars.name: sc_disable_spotlight_shadows
convars.label: Disable spotlight shadows
convars.description: Skips spotlight shadow rendering.

convars.name: sc_dithered_lod_transition_amt
convars.label: Dithered LOD transition amount
convars.description: Share of a level-of-detail transition that is dithered, 0 to 0.2.

convars.name: sc_enable_discard
convars.label: Alpha discard
convars.description: Allows alpha-tested materials to discard pixels.

convars.name: sc_fade_distance_scale_override
convars.label: Fade distance scale
convars.description: Scale on the distance at which objects fade in and out. -1 uses the engine default.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream FAQ: affects how far trooper health bars and jump pad wind are visible.

convars.name: sc_force_materials_batchable
convars.label: Force batchable materials
convars.description: Treats every material as batchable.

convars.name: sc_hdr_enabled_override
convars.label: HDR rendering
convars.description: Overrides HDR rendering: -1 default, 0 no HDR, 1 to 3 HDR buffer formats. 0 changes how bright areas and colors look.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_enable
convars.description: Allows the scene renderer to draw repeated copies of a mesh as instances.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_gpu_culling
convars.description: Lets the GPU discard mesh instances that do not need drawing.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_gpu_density_culling
convars.description: Lets the GPU reduce the number of mesh instances it draws based on density.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_lod_bias
convars.label: Instanced mesh LOD bias
convars.description: Level-of-detail bias for instanced meshes such as foliage and clutter. Higher values use simpler models.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_lod_bias_shadow
convars.label: Instanced mesh shadow LOD bias
convars.description: Level-of-detail bias for instanced meshes drawn into shadow maps. Higher values use simpler models for their shadows.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_motion_vectors
convars.label: Instanced mesh motion vectors
convars.description: Motion vectors for instanced meshes, used by temporal effects such as TAA upscaling and motion blur.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_opaque_fade
convars.label: Instanced mesh fade
convars.description: Lets opaque instanced meshes fade in and out.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_shadows_batch_across_materials
convars.description: Allows the instanced mesh shader to group shadow work across materials by reflectivity.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_size_cull_bias
convars.label: Instanced mesh cull bias
convars.description: Bias for culling small instanced meshes. Higher values hide more of them.

convars.name: sc_instanced_mesh_size_cull_bias_shadow
convars.label: Instanced mesh shadow cull bias
convars.description: Bias for leaving small instanced meshes (foliage, clutter) out of shadow maps. Higher values drop more of their shadows.

convars.name: sc_layer_batch_threshold
convars.label: Layer batch threshold
convars.description: Object count threshold for batching a render layer.

convars.name: sc_layer_batch_threshold_fullsort
convars.label: Layer full-sort threshold
convars.description: Object count threshold for fully sorting a render layer.

convars.name: sc_max_framebuffer_copies_per_layer
convars.label: Framebuffer copies per layer
convars.description: Maximum framebuffer copies per render layer, used by effects that sample the screen.

convars.name: sc_screen_size_lod_scale_override
convars.label: Model LOD scale
convars.description: Scale on when models switch to lower levels of detail. -1 uses the engine default; lower values switch sooner.
convars.sideEffects: Upstream FAQ: holes appear in Victor and Paige at some angles and the Sinner's Sacrifice lights turn into triangles.

convars.name: scene_clientflex
convars.description: Runs flex animation on the client.

convars.name: shake_show
convars.description: Lists the screen shakes currently playing.

convars.name: skeleton_instance_lod_optimization
convars.label: Skeleton LOD optimization
convars.description: Computes the level-of-detail bone mask internally instead of updating every bone.

convars.name: snd_boxverb_simd
convars.description: Uses SIMD instructions to process shoebox reverb.

convars.name: snd_diffusor_simd
convars.description: Uses SIMD instructions to process audio diffusion.

convars.name: snd_mix_async
convars.label: Async audio mixing
convars.description: Mixes audio asynchronously.

convars.name: snd_mixahead
convars.label: Audio mix-ahead
convars.description: Seconds of audio mixed ahead of playback. Higher values add audio latency.

convars.name: snd_occlusion_bounces
convars.label: Sound occlusion bounces
convars.description: Bounces traced for sound occlusion.

convars.name: snd_occlusion_rays
convars.label: Sound occlusion rays
convars.description: Rays traced for sound occlusion; 0 turns occlusion tracing off.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_enable_editor_profiling
convars.description: Collects Tracy profile data while Hammer bakes Steam Audio.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_enable_occlusion_caching
convars.description: Keeps the last occlusion result when Steam Audio cannot find a probe.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_enable_ordertruncated_ambisonics_hrtf
convars.description: Allows Steam Audio to load HRTFs with a reduced Ambisonic order.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_enable_perspective_correction
convars.description: Adjusts 3D audio for the listener's perspective.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_enable_reverb
convars.label: Steam Audio reverb
convars.description: Steam Audio's reverb processor.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_ir_duration
convars.description: Sets how long Steam Audio keeps sound reflections after the original sound starts.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_max_occlusion_samples
convars.label: Steam Audio occlusion samples
convars.description: Maximum rays Steam Audio traces for volumetric occlusion.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_num_diffuse_samples
convars.label: Steam Audio diffuse samples
convars.description: Directions Steam Audio considers for ray bounces.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_num_threads
convars.label: Steam Audio threads
convars.description: Threads Steam Audio uses for realtime reflections.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_reverb_order_rendering
convars.label: Steam Audio reverb order
convars.description: Ambisonics order for convolution reverb: 0 is one channel, 1 is four.

convars.name: snd_steamaudio_reverb_update_rate
convars.description: Limits how many times per second Steam Audio updates reverb.

convars.name: snd_use_baked_occlusion
convars.label: Baked sound occlusion
convars.description: Uses precomputed sound occlusion.

convars.name: soundsystem_update_async
convars.label: Async sound system update
convars.description: Updates the sound system asynchronously.

convars.name: sparseshadowtree_cs_exclude_next_cascade_region
convars.description: Skips unpacking the inside of a shadow cascade where a higher-resolution cascade already covers it.

convars.name: sparseshadowtree_disable_add_layers
convars.label: Disable SST runtime layers
convars.description: Debug option that leaves runtime layers out of the sparse shadow tree.

convars.name: sparseshadowtree_disable_for_viewmodel
convars.label: No SST for first-person models
convars.description: Uses regular cascaded shadow rendering for first-person models instead of the sparse shadow tree. On by default.

convars.name: sparseshadowtree_enable_rendering

presets.name: DMM Clean
presets.author: Deadlock Mod Manager
presets.blurb: The settings most community configs agree on, without anything that hides objects, changes the camera or what you can see, or overrides the in-game video menu.
notes: Derived from OptimizationLock (Sqooky, Eskay, Kaizuchaneru, boot, Piggy) and OptiLock (dacooderr), GPL-3.0.

presets.name: OptimizationLock
presets.author: Sqooky
presets.blurb: Sqooky's main config. Upstream describes it as performance-oriented without making the game ugly and recommends it for most players.
notes: Upstream FAQ: if buildings pop in, raise r_farz or remove r_mapextents; if Victor or Paige show holes, raise sc_screen_size_lod_scale_override.

presets.name: Eskay's Config
presets.author: Eskay
presets.blurb: A fork of Sqooky's config with moderate changes to suit Eskay's preferences.

presets.name: Sqooky's Max FPS
presets.author: Sqooky
presets.blurb: Sqooky's frame-rate-first config. Upstream marks it as under development and not fully documented.

source.path: maximumfps or minimum spec config and resources here/gameinfo.gi

notes: The in-game settings come from Liah's video.txt, which upstream ships next to this config.

presets.name: Kaizuchaneru's Minimum Spec
presets.author: Kaizuchaneru
presets.blurb: Prioritizes frame rate above all else and lowers visual quality a lot. Upstream recommends it for weak computers.
notes: Upstream FAQ: hero portraits in the shop and end screen go dark (citadel_portrait_world_renderer_off) and Lash's ground slam is hard to see (r_drawdecals).

presets.name: OptiLock FPS (Recommended)
presets.author: dacooderr
presets.blurb: dacooderr's recommended competitive config. Upstream ships it with a matching set of in-game video settings.

presets.name: OptiLock Potato
presets.author: dacooderr
presets.blurb: dacooderr's lowest-quality config for weak hardware. Upstream ships it with a matching set of in-game video settings.

presets.name: OptiLock Ultra Potato
presets.author: dacooderr
presets.blurb: OptiLock Potato with a shorter draw distance, lower model and decal detail, and more aggressive culling of small objects. For the weakest hardware.
notes: Buildings and distant players pop in sooner than with OptiLock Potato (r_farz, r_mapextents).
